inheritance: No change to original E01/E02 scientific definitions, metadata identity, all source fold IDs/landmarks, candidate pools, truth geometry or feature axes.
serialization_only_adapter: Within a documented context manager, call the immutable E01 baseline_features, convert only feature_names to Unicode dtype, and finally restore the original function. Numeric features and all fit arguments remain unchanged.
paired_delta: anonymous minus source_name; E01 per-field correctness and retrieval expected MRR/Hit1; E02 per-query NDCG/excess and per-group RSA. Exact atom/candidate/truth alignment required; NA retained.
aggregation: All three seed results retained. Equal-dose then equal-cell E02 means use original definitions. Seed ranges/means are mapping sensitivity, not independent-study confidence intervals or inferential n.
scientific_scope: Entity-name and lexical-form sensitivity; not isolated identification of pretrained biological knowledge or information leakage.
